author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two character art pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has availability right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info privately as this art is for my new unannounced book. No specific style in mind, but post examples of your work in the replies.

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica
title: Se buscan ilustradores for book promo characters
content: Se buscan ilustradores. Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo. Por favor, añadid vuestro portfolio y lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado. Todos los personajes son adultos, algunos demonios o seres mágicos. Novela adulta. Buscamos algo sencillo, colorido y con humor.

author: Two Chicks and a Plot Twist
title: Commission artist for Plot Twist Book Festival
content: We’re looking to commission an artist for Plot Twist Book Festival! We’re picturing pink fairytale vibes with a princess knight, flowers, books, and a kingdom, but we’re also open to incorporating our Two Chicks and a Plot Twist podcast branding. We have lots of ideas and would love to chat with artists about what could work best! If you’re interested, send us an IG dm with your portfolio and rates.
